title: ACTV Studio IRL: Vuori Bridgeport Village x YogaSix
description: Join Vuori Bridgeport Village for an ACTV Studio IRL on October 18th
long_description:
Join Vuori Bridgeport Village for an ACTV Studio IRL on October 18th

About this Event

Join Vuori Bridgeport for an in-store workout on Sunday, October 18th. Led by YogaSix, enjoy a bodyweight sculpt workout. After class, all attendees are invited in-store for exclusive discounted shopping & refreshments. 
9:00am - 10:00am: Class
10:00am - 11:00am: Shopping + Refreshments
RSVP to reserve your spot! Please be sure to bring a mat.

Also check out other Workshops in Portland.
